findings.explanation: 'Ai2000 is set to win as brands bring AI into the ERP' reuses the reference deck's 'is set to win as' line almost word for word.
Point 01 is about ERP vendors adding AI (e67), not about what changed for apparel brands.
Point 03 offers outbound and AI with no gap behind it; nothing cited shows Ai2000 lacks a sales motion.
BlueCherry is placed 'Ops only' because no financials were cited (e61, e62, e64); a page that doesn't mention financials doesn't show they are missing.
'Large-brand suites lack financials or stay generic': no cited quote says BlueCherry or Aptean lack financials.
AIMS360 appears as a typeset name next to real logos.
